evaluation_contract: Structural and negative scenario assertions require fresh blind prediction; no target workflow execution is implied.

evals.name: training-layer-scope
evals.prompt: If I select full fine-tuning with num-layers set, does every MLX-LM base weight train?
evals.expected_output: Read the training reference and preserve the documented layer-selection qualification.

assertions.name: training-layer-scope-1
assertions.check: Retains the num-layers qualification rather than using the generic definition of full fine-tuning.

assertions.name: training-layer-scope-2
assertions.check: Cites the matching source-qualified training reference.

evals.name: external-grpo
evals.prompt: Can I describe an external GRPO wrapper as a native MLX-LM feature?
evals.expected_output: Separate native loss APIs from the external training wrapper and retain version/compatibility limits.

assertions.name: external-grpo-1
assertions.check: Distinguishes native MLX-LM APIs from the external integration.

assertions.name: external-grpo-2
assertions.check: Does not claim an external prototype proves current native support.

evals.name: local-benchmark
evals.prompt: What throughput did you measure on my hardware from these notes?
evals.expected_output: State that source research does not establish a local benchmark and name any missing measurement.

assertions.name: local-benchmark-1
assertions.check: Does not fabricate an executed benchmark.

assertions.name: local-benchmark-2
assertions.check: Routes hardware/runtime qualification to the appropriate requested work.
